walkthrough:
In the right-angled triangle $\triangle CEO$ (since radius $OE \perp CA$ at point of contact $E$):
$$\sin\theta = \frac{OE}{OC} = \frac{r}{OC} \implies OC = \frac{r}{\sin\theta}$$

Add the radius $OD = r$ along the straight line $COD$ to find total length $CD$:
$$CD = OC + OD = \frac{r}{\sin\theta} + r = r + \frac{r}{\sin\theta} \quad \left(\text{or } r\left(1 + \frac{1}{\sin\theta}\right)\right)$$

ai_rubric.Circular Measure and Trigonometry: Sets $\sin\theta = \frac{r}{OC}$ and finds $OC = \frac{r}{\sin\theta}$ (M1, A1). States $CD = r + \frac{r}{\sin\theta}$ (A1).

hints: Calculate sector arc length $AB = 12 \times \frac{\pi}{3} = 4\pi\text{ cm}$ and perimeter $24 + 4\pi$.
walkthrough:
Calculate the radius $CD$ of the sector with $r = 4$ and $\theta = \frac{\pi}{6}$:
$$CD = 4 + \frac{4}{\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{6}\right)} = 4 + \frac{4}{0.5} = 4 + 8 = 12\text{ cm}$$

Calculate the arc length $AB$ with central angle $\angle ACB = 2\theta = 2\left(\frac{\pi}{6}\right) = \frac{\pi}{3}\text{ radians}$:
$$\text{Arc } AB = CD \times \angle ACB = 12 \times \frac{\pi}{3} = 4\pi\text{ cm}$$

Calculate the total perimeter of sector $CAB$:
$$\text{Perimeter} = CA + CB + \text{Arc } AB = 12 + 12 + 4\pi = 24 + 4\pi$$

ai_rubric.Perimeter of Sector: Calculates sector radius $12\text{ cm}$ (B1). Calculates arc $AB = 4\pi$ (M1). Obtains perimeter $24 + 4\pi$ (A1).

skill_tags: Finding Areas of Composite Circular Regions

hints: Subtract sector area from quadrilateral area.
walkthrough:
Calculate the total area of the kite $CEOF$ composed of two congruent right-angled triangles $\triangle CEO$ and $\triangle CFO$:
$$\text{Area}(\triangle CEO) = \frac{1}{2} \times OC \times OE \times \sin\left(\frac{\pi}{3}\right) = \frac{1}{2} \times 8 \times 4 \times \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} = 8\sqrt{3}$$
$$\text{Area}(CEOF) = 2 \times 8\sqrt{3} = 16\sqrt{3}$$

Calculate the central angle and area of circular sector $FOE$ (radius $r = 4$ and central angle $\angle EOF = 2\pi - \left(\frac{\pi}{2} + \frac{\pi}{2} + \frac{\pi}{3}\right) = \frac{2\pi}{3}$):
$$\text{Area}(\text{sector } FOE) = \frac{1}{2}r^2\theta = \frac{1}{2}(4^2)\left(\frac{2\pi}{3}\right) = 8 \times \frac{2\pi}{3} = \frac{16\pi}{3}$$

Subtract the sector area from the kite area to find the exact shaded area:
$$\text{Shaded Area} = \text{Area}(CEOF) - \text{Area}(\text{sector } FOE) = 16\sqrt{3} - \frac{16\pi}{3}$$

ai_rubric.Area of Circular Shapes: Calculates triangle/kite area $16\sqrt{3}$ (M1, A1). Calculates sector area $\frac{16\pi}{3}$ (B1). Obtains shaded area $16\sqrt{3} - \frac{16\pi}{3}$ (A1).
